color-fg.$description: Default text color on light backgrounds. Paired with color-bg, contrast ratio is ~15.3:1 (WCAG AAA).

color-primary.$description: Primary brand/action color used for buttons, links, and focus accents.

color-primary-fg.$description: Text/icon color for content placed on top of color-primary. Contrast against color-primary is ~5.2:1 (WCAG AA).

color-border.$description: Default border color for cards, inputs, and dividers.

color-surface.$description: Slightly raised surface background, e.g. cards on top of color-bg.

color-danger.$description: Destructive/error color for delete actions and error states.

color-danger-fg.$description: Text/icon color for content placed on top of color-danger.

color-muted-fg.$description: Secondary/muted text color, e.g. helper text and placeholders.

space-1.$description: Smallest spacing step, used for tight gaps (e.g. icon-to-label).

space-2.$description: Base spacing step, used for compact padding and gaps.

space-3.$description: Medium spacing step, used for component padding.

space-4.$description: Large spacing step, used for section/card padding.

radius-sm.$description: Corner radius for small controls like chips and inputs.

radius-md.$description: Corner radius for buttons and form controls.

radius-lg.$description: Corner radius for cards and large containers.

font-size-sm.$description: Small text size, used for helper/caption text and chips.

font-size-lg.$description: Large text size, used for headings and emphasis.

border-width-sm.$description: Default hairline border width used across inputs, chips, and cards.

font-family-base.$description: Default system font stack for body text and UI.
font-family-base.$value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

font-weight-bold.$description: Bold text weight, used for headings and emphasis.

shadow-card.$description: Subtle elevation shadow used on cards.

button-primary-background.$description: Alias to the base brand color for primary button backgrounds.

button-primary-foreground.$description: Alias for text/icon color on primary buttons.

button-primary-radius.$description: Alias for primary button corner radius.

button-danger-background.$description: Alias to the base danger color for destructive button backgrounds.

button-danger-foreground.$description: Alias for text/icon color on danger buttons.

card-default-background.$description: Alias to the base surface color for card backgrounds.

card-default-border.$description: Alias to the base border color for card outlines.
